items.title: Witch Gathering Seashells
items.alt: A coastal witch places a spiral seashell in a small woven bucket.
items.description: A coastal witch wearing rolled trousers and a wide pointed hat crouches to place one spiral shell into a little woven bucket. Use this illustration for personal seaside fantasy journals and personal crafts.

items.title: Witch Releasing Fireflies
items.alt: A witch opens a glass jar and releases three fireflies.
items.description: A smiling witch lifts the lid of a glass jar as three small fireflies rise above the opening, warm shapes without luminous background haze. Use this illustration for nighttime nature story cards and personal crafts.

items.title: Witch Helping a Snail
items.alt: A kneeling witch lays a leaf bridge between two stones for a snail.
items.description: A kneeling witch carefully lays a broad leaf as a tiny bridge for a snail between two smooth stones. Use this illustration for kindness story sequencing and personal crafts.
